name: text-to-cad
title_zh: CAD/CAE/CAM 三域技能库，建模到仿真一条龙
tagline_zh: 不用记一堆命令，从画草图到有限元分析再到生成加工代码，一个库全包。装完它，你的 AI 助手直接变身机械工程师。
tagline_en: Skip scattered commands. Sketch, simulate, and generate toolpaths through one unified skill set. Your AI becomes.
desc_en: A library of agent skills for CAD, CAE and CAM
why_zh: 把分散的 CAD、CAE、CAM 技能收进同一套调用协议，模型能跨域接力，不用你手动搬运数据。
why_en: Unifies CAD, CAE, and CAM skills under one protocol, letting models hand off data seamlessly across domains without manual file.
limit_zh: 只覆盖主流开源工具链（如 FreeCAD、OpenFOAM 等），商业软件（SolidWorks。
limit_en: Covers only mainstream open-source tools (FreeCAD, OpenFOAM, etc.); commercial suites need custom adapters. Not for ultra-precision tolerances.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: CAD/CAE/CAM skill library: model, simulate, fabricate
